action_request.instruction: Approach the block and align the gripper. Lower the gripper to the grasp pose. Close the gripper on the block. Lift the block. Move the block toward the destination while reorienting it. Lower the block into the target region. Open the gripper to release the block. Move the gripper away from the placed block.

policy_contract.statistical_limit: 30 near-film variants are clustered in 15 parent families; 90 synthetic layouts are independently sampled within the familiar task, not 90 new task families. Legacy and personal cases are development data, not pristine blind test data.
policy_contract.physical_scale_limit: M0-derived normalized layout mapped to a declared virtual tabletop. No measured physical metre accuracy.

original775.inference: Original scenario-weighted primary contrast; 5000 paired family-cluster bootstrap, 50000 cluster sign flips, seed61117, Holm over10 strict contrasts. Repeated near-scenes grouped by parent; 125 clusters assumed. No new posthoc significance test.
original775.exposure: Includes training-derived, previously inspected and legacy scenes; even novel synthetic scenes use familiar geometry/task. Human take families can share original recordings. Not775 independent demonstrations.
original775.claim: Strict gains are initially-complete preservation. V3 has4 new correctly oriented released/stable in-square placements on the labelled posthoc region endpoint; original centre criterion not changed.

config.history_contract: Actual causal robot RGB, native saved-frame rate; paired cameras, chronological timestamps. Per-camera frame native vision features mean-pooled; explicit time/camera encoding; history vision branch no-grad; exact per-frame feature cache only for M3/M4 whose entire vision encoder remains frozen; M5/M6 recompute each step. Capacity compression pools adjacent encoded tokens without dropping source images.
config.initialization: Pinned fresh base; isolated row29 copied from pretrained domain3 or freshly reset, as explicitly configured. No old fine-tuned weights unless init_checkpoint is declared.
config.paper_distinction: Explicit warmup/ramp/joint counts; smoke counts do not reproduce the1000/1000/1000paper-scale schedule.

annotation_conditioning.held_sidecar: held_value*valid and validity, UNKNOWN remains0/false; no grasp action label is invented
